query.commandtext: SELECT MAP_CFG_SEQ, TESTAREA, DEVICE_ALIAS, PROGRAM, ALTER_ANGLE, ALTER_INDEX_X, ALTER_INDEX_Y, CREATE_USER, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME, USER_COMMENT FROM TQP_MAPCFG WHERE 1 = 1 AND TESTAREA = :testarea AND DEVICE_ALIAS = :device AND PROGRAM IN (:pgm, 'ALL') AND NVL(DELETE_FLAG, 'N') = 'N' ORDER BY DECODE(PROGRAM, 'ALL', 99999, 1), MAP_CFG_SEQ DESC

INSERT INTO TQP_MAPCFG ( MAP_CFG_SEQ, REV_NO, TESTAREA, DEVICE_ALIAS, PROGRAM, ALTER_DIRECTION, ALTER_ANGLE, ALTER_INDEX_X, ALTER_INDEX_Y, CREATE_USER, CREATE_TIME, USER_COMMENT ) VALUES ( MAP_CFG_SEQ.NEXTVAL, :rev_no, :testarea, :device_alias, :pgm, :alter_dir, :alter_angle, :alter_index_x, :alter_index_y, :create_user, SYSDATE, :user_comment )

--UPDATE TQP_MAPCFG SET ALTER_ANGLE = :alter_angle, ALTER_INDEX_X = :alter_index_x, ALTER_INDEX_Y = :alter_index_y, UPDATE_USER = :update_user, UPDATE_TIME = SYSDATE, USER_COMMENT = :user_comment WHERE 1 = 1 AND TESTAREA = :testarea AND DEVICE_ALIAS = :device_alias AND PROGRAM = :pgm
UPDATE TQP_MAPCFG SET DELETE_FLAG = 'Y', UPDATE_USER = :update_user, UPDATE_TIME = SYSDATE WHERE 1 = 1 AND TESTAREA = :testarea AND DEVICE_ALIAS = :device AND PROGRAM = :pgm

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT /*+ INDEX_DESC(A PK_TQP_MAPCFG) */ ALTER_DIRECTION, ALTER_ANGLE, ALTER_INDEX_X, ALTER_INDEX_Y FROM TQP_MAPCFG A WHERE 1 = 1 AND TESTAREA = :TESTAREA AND DEVICE_ALIAS = :DEVICE_ALIAS AND PROGRAM = :PROGRAM UNION ALL SELECT /*+ INDEX_DESC(A PK_TQP_MAPCFG) */ ALTER_DIRECTION, ALTER_ANGLE, ALTER_INDEX_X, ALTER_INDEX_Y FROM TQP_MAPCFG A WHERE 1 = 1 AND TESTAREA = :TESTAREA AND DEVICE_ALIAS = :DEVICE_ALIAS AND PROGRAM = 'ALL' ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1
SELECT * FROM TQP_MAPCFG WHERE 1 = 1 AND TESTAREA = :testarea AND DEVICE_ALIAS = :device AND PROGRAM = :pgm AND NVL(DELETE_FLAG, 'N') = 'N' ORDER BY DECODE(PROGRAM, 'ALL', 99999, 1), MAP_CFG_SEQ DESC
SELECT DISTINCT PROGRAM FROM TQP_MAPCFG WHERE 1 = 1 AND TESTAREA = 'MULTIPROBE' AND DEVICE_ALIAS = :device ORDER BY PROGRAM

SELECT MAP_CFG_SEQ, REV_NO, 'RevNO : ' ||LPAD(REV_NO, 2, '0') || ' (SEQ : ' || LPAD(MAP_CFG_SEQ, 5, '0') || ')' AS SEQ_REV_NO, TESTAREA, DEVICE_ALIAS, PROGRAM, ALTER_DIRECTION, ALTER_ANGLE, ALTER_INDEX_X, ALTER_INDEX_Y, CREATE_USER, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME, USER_COMMENT, DELETE_FLAG FROM TQP_MAPCFG WHERE 1 = 1 ?? ORDER BY TESTAREA, DEVICE_ALIAS, PROGRAM, REV_NO
SELECT * FROM TQP_MAPCFG WHERE 1 = 1 AND TESTAREA = :testarea AND DEVICE_ALIAS = :device AND PROGRAM = :pgm ORDER BY REV_NO DESC
UPDATE TQP_MAPCFG SET DELETE_FLAG = 'Y', UPDATE_USER = :update_user, UPDATE_TIME = SYSDATE, USER_COMMENT = :user_comment WHERE 1 = 1 AND MAP_CFG_SEQ = :map_seq

SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM TQP_MAPCFG WHERE 1 = 1 AND TESTAREA = :testarea AND DEVICE_ALIAS = :device) WHERE :prgram LIKE PROGRAM ESCAPE '\' OR PROGRAM = 'ALL' AND DELETE_FLAG = 'N' ORDER BY CASE WHEN PROGRAM = 'ALL' THEN 1000 WHEN INSTR (PROGRAM, '%') > 0 THEN 2000 WHEN INSTR (PROGRAM, '_') > 0 THEN 3000 ELSE 10000 END + LENGTH (PROGRAM) DESC
SELECT * FROM TQP_MAPCFG WHERE 1 = 1 AND MAP_CFG_SEQ = :cfg_seq
